desc: Derive the exact contribution formula for one fixed element, including suffix subsets and permutation multiplicities.
Find a subquadratic/closed-form evaluation of the factorial-weighted subset polynomial functional using the at-most-six distinct digit lengths.
Handle removal of one selected element from its digit-length class efficiently and combine with class value sums.
Verify the complete derivation and implementation on \(N=1\), \(N=3\), and modular edge cases.
Produce the final stdin/stdout Python implementation.
